title: Composition of the normalized etale source comparison
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions] and the canonical exceptional composition, normalized etale source comparison and derived pullback composition [def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition, lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization, lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Let $q:A\to B$, $J:R\to A$ and $H:W\to R$ be separated finite-type $k$-morphisms between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with $J,H$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Put $\omega_q=Rq^!\Lambda$. The canonical map $E_{HJ,q}:\omega_{(HJ)q}\to L(HJ)^*\omega_q$ is the following composite: first the canonical exceptional congruence for $((H J)q)=H(Jq)$ at $\Lambda$, then $E_{H,Jq}$, then $LH^*E_{J,q}$, then the inverse canonical pullback compositor $LH^*LJ^*\omega_q\to L(HJ)^*\omega_q$. No smoothness or Cartesian hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Expand E_HJ,q as c_HJ,q followed by rho_HJ at omega_q. The mate-pasting law applied to compact-support composition associativity identifies c_HJ,q followed by c_H,J at omega_q with the associativity congruence followed by c_H,Jq and H-exceptional pullback of c_J,q. Substitute the normalization composition law for rho_HJ. Naturality of rho_H moves the exceptional pullback of c_J,q through rho_H to its ordinary derived pullback. Compose with the pullback compositor inverse and cancel its hom. The resulting factors are exactly E_H,Jq followed by H-pullback of E_J,q and the inverse pullback compositor, as asserted.

theorem etale_composite_e_composition
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B A R W : Scheme.{u}}
    [B.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (B ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [A.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (A ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [R.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (R ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (R ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [W.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (W ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (q : A ⟶ B) [q.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated q] [LocallyOfFiniteType q] [QuasiCompact q]
    (J : R ⟶ A) [J.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated J] [LocallyOfFiniteType J] [QuasiCompact J]
    (H : W ⟶ R) [H.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated H] [LocallyOfFiniteType H] [QuasiCompact H]
    [Etale J] [Etale H] :
    (sourceEtale P (H ≫ J) q).hom =
      (FiniteEtaleNormalization.congr P ((H ≫ J) ≫ q)
        (H ≫ J ≫ q) (Category.assoc H J q)).hom.app
        (coefficientUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B) ≫
      (sourceEtale P H (J ≫ q)).hom ≫
      (pull P H).map (sourceEtale P J q).hom ≫
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) H J).inv.app
        (omega P q)
